# SartorialAI

> SartorialAI is an AI front desk and revenue system for small and mid-size businesses. A team of named AI agents answers every call, books appointments, qualifies and follows up on leads 24/7, and builds a complete go-to-market plan from your website. Free to start, live in 48 hours, no setup fees. SartorialAI is a trademark of Sartorial Digital, LLC.

## What it does

- Front Desk: answers calls, chats, and texts 24/7, books appointments, and qualifies leads (agents Aria, Max, Zane, Savannah)
- Growth, Brand, and Operations: lead follow-up, email sequences, content, and reporting (agents Nova, Dax, Reese, Kai)
- GTM Engine: turns a website URL into an ideal customer profile, a starter lead list, a 5-email sequence, a content plan, and ready-to-publish posts
- Pricing: free to start, with paid plans from $497 per month

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.sartorialai.co/): platform overview, agent team, pricing, and FAQ
- [Solutions by industry](https://www.sartorialai.co/solutions): hub for every vertical
- [Home services](https://www.sartorialai.co/home-services): HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, and contractors
- [Medical and dental](https://www.sartorialai.co/medical-dental): patient scheduling and front desk
- [Law firms](https://www.sartorialai.co/law-firms): legal intake and consultation booking
- [Med spas](https://www.sartorialai.co/med-spas): booking and front desk for aesthetic clinics
- [Real estate](https://www.sartorialai.co/real-estate): lead response and showing scheduling
- [Restaurants and retail](https://www.sartorialai.co/restaurants-retail): reservations, catering, and call answering
